messages:
sam: :rotating_light: alert from incident-bot: Hosted API p95/p99 latency spike and growing request backlog. seeing 5xx/timeouts. Investigating.
incident-bot: [INCIDENT] hosted-api-high-queue - priority: P1 - triggered by threshold breach: hosted.request_queue > 2000 for 3m. Paging oncall.
ops-bot: auto-scaling attempted but hit pool_limit on gpu-hosted-pool-3 (max_instances=24). scale request queued.
maria: I’m on it — pulling metrics. p95 = 1.8s -> 4.2s, p99 = 3.5s -> 12.4s in the last 6m. queue len went from ~600 -> 9.2k. errors: 504/timeouts and model OOM retries.
lee: any recent deploys? deploy-bot, did we push a model or config in last 30m?
deploy-bot: last successful deploy to hosted-api: 1782102020 by release-ci (no model change). No canary failures.
maria: not a deploy. traffic pattern shows an external customer spiked steady requests with longer contexts. average seq length up from 512 to 1700 tokens. big cache miss rate.
sam: paging PD: @kai are you available to take handoff if needed?
kai: I’m available. clues: autoscaler failing because GPU init time larger due to big model variant (1.2T), and we have concurrency limits on the pool. we’re also hitting per-region quota on GPU count.
maria: mitigation idea 1: enable emergency fallback routing to smaller-quantized variant (v1.q8) for new requests. idea 2: hard-limit max-req-per-ip temporarily. idea 3: enable prefix caching.
lee: can we flip fallback now? what’s the rollback command?
maria: run:
```
# route new requests to quantized fallback
redwoodctl route update hosted-api --target-model redwood/gptx-1.q8 --filter 'latency>2s' --force
```
ops-bot: attempted to route 20s ago, failed with 403: insufficient permission for route update (role: infra-ops).
sam: @maria can you push the change? I’ll escalate perms if needed?
maria: pushing via admin console. doing change now.
maria: done — routing rule active. observing metrics...
maria: queue decreased from 9.2k -> 4.6k in 90s. p95 down to 2.7s, p99 ~7.1s. errors still ~2.1% of requests.
kai: we still have some long-running in-flight requests pinned to saturated GPUs. plan: drain lowest-priority queues, cancel stale long requests older than 30s.
lee: approved. run cancellation via admin: `redwoodctl queue trim --age 30s --priority low`
ops-bot: trimming queue: 1483 low-priority requests cancelled.
sam: good — that shaved more backlog. p95 ~2.1s, p99 ~5.8s. errors down to 1.4%.
kai: next: autoscale retry after increasing pool limit. requested quota bump from cloud team for region-eu-west-1 to +8 GPUs. pinging infra-reqs.
maria: customer impact update: approximately 6% of requests from a single tenant saw timeouts or degraded responses during the peak window. flagging for post-incident follow-up.
lee: any manual capacity addition option? spin up Dedicated fallback?
kai: Dedicated pools require contract binding; we have a standby dedicated pool with 4 GPUs we can route a small % of traffic to. Turning that on for the tenant temporarily.
maria: routing 20% of tenant traffic to dedicated-fallback now.
maria: tenant traffic routed. their errors drop to 0.6% within a minute. overall p99 improved to 4.2s.
sam: thanks. I'm going to open a severity page and notify CS for customer comms. Maria/Kai take lead on mitigation until I handoff.
incident-bot: oncall handoff reminder: @maria -> @kai in 55m per schedule.
sam: formal handoff at 18:20 UTC. @kai you own next 2h. please maintain updates every 15m or on visible change.
kai: acknowledged. next steps: follow up with cloud quota team, validate autoscaler bug (race when pool at max_instances), add temporary admission control to reject requests with seq>1200 for 20m.
maria: implementing seq-length admission: `redwoodctl admissions set --max-context 1200 --reason "emergency backpressure"`
ops-bot: admission rule applied.
maria: monitoring — queue now at 1.1k, p95 1.6s, p99 3.1s. timeouts < 0.5%.
sam: summary for pager duty and postmortem: root cause: incoming tenant traffic spike with long contexts + cache miss -> GPU memory pressure -> autoscaler hit hard cap and failed to provision additional instances -> backlog and p99 blowup. Mitigations: emergency routing to quantized model, queue trimming, admission control, tenant-specific reroute to dedicated pool.
lee: will draft an incident timeline and impact numbers. assigning to infra for autoscaler fix: `INFRA-5423` (race when pool==max).
kai: noted. I’ll keep monitoring. if quota bump isn’t approved in 30m, we’ll keep admissions and scaling workarounds.
sam: good work everyone. leave thread updates here. logging incident ticket and tagging cs+security. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Incident status changed to mitigated (partial) — monitoring.
maria: handoff to @kai now — I'm pausing active changes, handing control to Kai.
kai: taking over. I'll post a status check in 15m.
sam: end of primary coordination. followup: RCA, customer comms, and autoscaler bug owner assignment.
